function: Specify a part of composite section, through which a selected tendon profile is passing. This data is used to calculate the net area of prestressed concrete section. Note 1 If this is not specified, it is assumed that tendon profiles pass through Part1.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [Load] tab > [Type : Prestress] > [Prestress Loads] group > [Tendon Location for Composite Section]
usage:
Tendon Location for Composite Section

Tendon Profile : Select a tendon profile

Composite Section for C.S : A composite section for construction stage is automatically selected based on the selected tendon profile.

Part number : Specify part number through which a selected tendon profile passes.
